scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && concurrently --kill-others --names automation,operator,demo-api,demo-web "pnpm --filter @interface-ai/automation dev" "pnpm --filter @interface-ai/operator dev" "pnpm --filter @interface-ai/demo-api dev" "pnpm --filter @interface-ai/demo-web dev"
scripts.dev:automation: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/automation dev
scripts.dev:demo-api: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/demo-api dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && vitest run
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.db:up: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --import tsx scripts/database.ts up
scripts.db:down: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --import tsx scripts/database.ts down
scripts.db:setup: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --import tsx scripts/database.ts setup
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --import tsx scripts/database.ts migrate
scripts.db:reset-demo: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --import tsx scripts/database.ts reset-demo
scripts.test:db: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --env-file=.env.database ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.demo:serve: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/demo-web build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/demo-api build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/demo-api start
scripts.executor:check: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/automation executor:check
scripts.automation:reconcile: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --env-file=apps/automation/.env --import tsx scripts/reconcile-automation.ts
scripts.workflow:demo: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --env-file=apps/automation/.env --import tsx scripts/workflow-demo.ts

scripts.scenario:controls: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --env-file=apps/automation/.env --import tsx scripts/check-target-controls.ts
scripts.handoff:demo: pnpm --filter @interface-ai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @interface-ai/postgres build && node --env-file=apps/automation/.env --import tsx scripts/handoff-demo.ts
